protocol.question: Does reserve movement interact with the timing of food availability?
protocol.status: Exploratory; not adopted as main project findings.
protocol.movement: Translate remaining reserve only, +2 y cells before release; zero replenishment.
protocol.capture_phase: After all operations of the labeled completed update. Feeding/Paused names describe release at that update, not the next update. At update 0 release has not started.
protocol.planned_analysis: Compare occupancy (genome >= 0), spatial disagreement, within-phase occupancy changes, colonization and radiation gains, and movement x feeding differences at both feeding and complete-cycle ends. Single seed; no universal strategy ranking.

accounting.reserve_residual_bound: sum over release steps: 0.5 * float32 spacing(max initial capacity) * initial source cells; subtraction rounding only, no correction.
accounting.rationale: Float32 rate/addition/subtraction round; accumulate measured changes in float64. One ppm defines material end-of-experiment supply mismatch, not biological significance. Exact reserve replay must also pass. Record residuals without rescaling.

protocol.scope: Four specified conditions only. No schedule tuning, new physics, ASAL search, main-result edits, commits or pushes.

interpretation.question_in_plain_language: We previously changed where food appeared. This optional experiment changes when it becomes available and tests whether that interacts with movement.
interpretation.phase_response: At every sampled feeding end, pulsed occupancy exceeds steady occupancy for both motion settings; at every complete-cycle/pause end it is lower. Counts use genome >= 0.
interpretation.movement_interaction: The movement-by-pulsing difference of differences changes sign across complete cycles. At update 1000, moving minus fixed is 595 occupied cells under steady release and 800 under pulsed release (interaction +205). One seed cannot establish a general interaction.
interpretation.spatial_response: At update 1000, fixed versus moving differs at 33177 occupied locations under steady release and 26358 under pulsed release; endpoint totals do not describe spatial occupancy.
interpretation.usefulness: Useful as an optional demonstration that feeding phase changes the apparent endpoint ranking. Keep exploratory pending review; evidence for a general movement interaction is insufficient.

OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 TI_CPU_MAX_NUM_THREADS=1 optional/feeding_cycles/.local/venv/bin/python -m unittest optional.feeding_cycles.test_feeding_cycles test_controller_lookup test_controller_integration test_dynamic_energy test_food_presentation -q

limitations: One seed and one bounded schedule; no causal mechanism or universal strategy ranking established.
Serial CPU requested; Taichi RNG/kernel/atomic ordering is not fully captured by Python/NumPy/Torch RNG equality.
Float32 reserve subtraction and energy addition residuals are retained without correction; see resource_budgets.
Initial background infrastructure and stored energy can buffer pauses; radiation reseeds throughout.
Captures are every 25 updates; per-update event/resource logs verify intervening feeding and movement timing.

figure.boundary_alignment: Integer updates 1..100 feed and 101..200 pause; shading edges at 0.5/100.5, 200.5/300.5, etc. Update 0 is unshaded.

review.simulation_execution_record: Original provenance, checks, resource_budgets, and float32 residuals are preserved; this analysis ran no simulation.

validation.full_run_validation: Reused recorded checks; no new ecosystem simulation.
validation.cleanup: Removed duplicate validation-log copying and an unreachable conditional; retained all original results and raw data.
